plexito-de-honed-skills-blockkit-forge.description: Use when building a Slack Block Kit message from real data that a bot will post, update or thread, such as a notification card, a ticket or case log, a digest, or a status that changes. Covers the live enums (read from blocks.validate, which knows more block types than the docs), a dry-post as the bot (a message scheduled a week out, deleted, the queue read back), Builder preview, text from another system made safe (escape order, cut before escape, verbatim, HTML to mrkdwn, URLs), scannable cards, collapsed long text, status pills, people tagged without a ping, live updates and thread…

plexito-de-honed-skills-comb-pdf-form-fi.description: Use when filling an official PDF form to print, sign or submit, and each character has to land inside its own printed box (a comb field) - IBAN, tax number, BIC, postcode, dates. Covers German Behörden-, Steuer- and Bank-Vordrucke (SEPA-Lastschriftmandat, Finanzamt and insurer forms) and any AcroForm or flat PDF with printed boxes. Triggers on comb field, Kästchen, one letter per box, Vordruck, Formular ausfüllen, fillable PDF, AcroForm, flatten PDF, and on filled text that crosses the box dividers or will not fit.

plexito-de-honed-skills-din5008-letter.description: Use when a German letter (Brief, Geschäftsbrief) has to be printed and posted in a DIN lang window envelope (Fensterumschlag), laid out to DIN 5008 Form B, such as a Kündigung, Widerspruch, Einspruch or a letter to a Behörde. Needs only sender and recipient; every optional part (Rücksendeangabe, Vermerk, Informationsblock, Datum, Betreff, Anrede, Text, Gruß, Anlagen) goes to its normed place, with Falz- and Lochmarken. Refuses an address the window cannot take and proves the PDF layout. Not for Form A or a logo letterhead.

plexito-de-honed-skills-drive-audit.description: Use when anything in Google Drive might be shared that should not be, or when a share has to be removed, reviewed or approved. Fires on "who can see this", "stop sharing", "make it private", "anyone with the link", "public", "shared with", "unshare", "revoke access", "sharing audit", "Freigabe", "nicht mehr teilen", "nur für mich". Owns the drive-audit CLI (scan, folder, revoke, downgrade, reparent, policy), how to read each finding class, what counts as an approved share, and how to keep a policy file so the next run is a diff rather than a re-read.

plexito-de-honed-skills-excalidraw.description: Use when producing a diagram as a .excalidraw file, or when asked for an architecture, flow, sequence, tree, mind map, org chart, timeline, network, ERD, swimlane, kanban or wireframe drawing that should look hand-drawn. Writes a short spec and expands it deterministically with measured font metrics, real layout and correct arrow bindings, then lints and renders it. Triggers on excalidraw, diagram, sketch, whiteboard, architecture diagram, flowchart, sequence diagram, mind map, hand-drawn, and on a diagram that opens with overlapping boxes or detached arrows.

plexito-de-honed-skills-human-review.description: Put a draft in front of the person you are working for and get their markup back in one batch: they retype text, comment on any selection, and circle or scribble on images and PDF pages with a note per mark. Use before anything they will read, print or publish: post, spec, plan, report, newsletter, landing page, deck, invitation, poster, chart, rendered design, screenshot.

plexito-de-honed-skills-qr-code.description: Use when a QR code has to be made or checked and must scan correctly, such as a SEPA payment code (EPC QR code, GiroCode, Überweisung per QR-Code, EPC069-12) for an invoice, or a QR code for a URL, a donation or payment link, a printed card or poster, with or without a logo in the middle and a caption below. Refuses input a scanner would read differently (an IBAN that fails its checksum, a name over 70 characters, hidden characters, a word that mixes Latin and Cyrillic letters, data too long to fit beside a logo) and proves that the finished image decodes to exactly the input. A card is also…

plexito-de-honed-skills-screenshot-callo.description: Use when a screenshot needs arrows, boxes, numbered steps, callouts, highlights, an underline, a spotlight, a magnifier or a redaction, for a guide, a support answer, a bug report, a review or a slide. Triggers on annotate, mark up, circle this, point an arrow at, number the steps, highlight, black out, blur or hide the key in a screenshot; on a figure that should look hand-drawn (rough.js, Excalidraw style) or be handed over editable in Excalidraw; on a human-review batch of rough circles to redraw cleanly; and BEFORE writing any one-off Pillow, ImageMagick, sharp or canvas script to draw on…

plexito-de-honed-skills-screenshot-overl.description: Use when two screenshots of the same screen each show a different transient overlay (a hover tooltip, a popover, a hover toolbar, an open menu) and one image has to show both. Also when someone says "combine these two screenshots", "put both tooltips in one image", "align these and merge the difference", or hands over two captures that are a few pixels apart. Aligns the captures on the pixels they share, numbers every component where they differ, and pastes the picked overlay along its own outline. Refuses when the captures do not line up, such as a different zoom. On a list, a table or a…

plexito-de-honed-skills-video-to-reading.description: Use when a device's display was filmed and every value on it has to be read back, especially a meter, gauge or appliance scrolled through its stored history. Covers seven-segment and LCD panels, handheld footage, and any long series where the answer is only useful if NO value was missed. Triggers on read a meter from video, values off a display, scrolled through the readings, stored daily values, seven-segment, LCD readout, frames from a video of a screen, and on a series that has to be proven complete rather than mostly right.
